title: Knowledge Inheritance Rules
description: Rules for Inheritance-level dependencies (structural/classificatory parentage). Specification only.

inheritance_kinds.description: Concept inherits pack-level constraints and design scope.
Concept inherits module identity and module standards.
Child concept specializes a parent concept without replacing the parent definition.
Record structure inherits from an authoring template family (documentation-level).

rules.statement: Inheritance MUST NOT mutate the parent Canonical Definition.
Specialization children MUST declare Hard or Inheritance dependency on the parent concept.
Multiple inheritance of conflicting classificatory parents REQUIRES conflict notes or CONFLICTS_WITH tracking.
Inheritance edges participate in acyclicity checks with Hard Dependency.
Pack/Module inheritance is organizational; it does not replace Concept-to-Concept foundation links.

override_interaction: Field-level overrides of inherited metadata follow override_policy.json; academic substance overrides require change request after freeze.
